description: Lint the prose of report.json (or the report object given) against the house style guide: percent in words, no first person, small numbers spelled out, plain words, sentence length. Returns the score (percent of sentences with no issue; target 90) and every sentence with its issues. Nothing is written into the report. build_report already returns the score and the first issues.

report.description: A report.json object; default: the workspace's report.json

name: style_check
title: Check the report's style
